description:
Microsoft built a $3 trillion empire on one fragile partnership.
Billions flowed into OpenAI, and straight back into Azure, creating the illusion of unstoppable growth.

But behind the scenes, OpenAI is burning cash, hardware is becoming obsolete fast, and cheaper competitors are crushing margins.

Now, the partnership is starting to break.
This isn’t just business, It’s a ticking time bomb that could reshape the entire AI industry.

Who collapses first?
